name: repertoire
description: Repertoire: skills for Claude Code and Cowork, plus an opt-in SearXNG search server for the research skill.

plugins.name: repertoire
plugins.description: Skills for Claude Code and Cowork: create and review skills, research a topic with parallel subagents, write changelogs, READMEs and CLAUDE.md files, draw Mermaid diagrams, design frontends, and find more skills.

plugins.name: repertoire-searxng
plugins.description: Adds the SearXNG MCP server (mcp-searxng) so the research skill can search the web through your own SearXNG instance. Needs SearXNG already running at http://localhost:8888 with the JSON format enabled; the plugin starts only the connector. Runs in Claude Code and desktop Cowork, not in cloud Cowork sessions.
